scope: Global provider API authentication, sandbox and authorized onboarding documentation. This is an incremental SKIM layer over the existing 178-entry global banking registry, NOT a replacement and NOT all providers fully researched.
method: Coordinated TinyFish public web discovery and official provider document fetches; reviewed documentary evidence, no login or live API credential issuance
